notes:
A versatile noun derived from the verb ⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧ (to return). Each sense has distinct usage patterns.

SENSE 1 — COMEBACK:
Very common in conversation about comedy (⟦{漫才|まんざい}→漫才：04458_manzai⟧, variety shows) and everyday banter. A key skill in Japanese comedy is the {返|かえ}し — the ability to respond to a setup (⟦ボケ→ボケ：08822_boke⟧) with a sharp retort (⟦ツッコミ→ツッコミ：09412_tsukkomi⟧).

SENSE 2 — RETURNING:
Often used with the honorific お as お{返|かえ}し, especially for return gifts. ⟦ホワイトデー→ホワイトデー：25279_howaitodee⟧ (White Day, March 14) is built around the concept of お{返|かえ}し — returning Valentine's chocolates.

SENSE 3 — COOKING:
A foundational element of Japanese noodle cuisine. {返|かえ}し is aged for days to mellow the flavors before being combined with dashi.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {返|かえ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまい→うまい：01279_umai⟧ — good at retorts
- お{返|かえ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — in return
- {本|ほん}{返|かえ}し — fully heated base sauce (cooking)
- ⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧{返|かえ}し — unheated base sauce (cooking)
